claim: Firewall Manager protection policies are priced with a monthly fee per Region, except AWS Shield protection policies, whose price is included in the Shield Advanced subscription; the AWS WAF web ACLs and rules and the AWS Config rules that Firewall Manager creates are charged based on current pricing.

values.display: priced with a monthly fee per region

qualifiers.condition: AWS Shield protection policies need a Shield Advanced subscription

evidence.quote: AWS Firewall Manager protection policies are priced with a monthly fee per region (see pricing below).
AWS WAF WebACLs or Rules - Those created by Firewall Manager will be charged based on current pricing.
AWS Config Rules - Those rules created by Firewall Manager to monitor changes in resource configurations are charged based on current pricing.
AWS Shield protection policies can be created using AWS Firewall Manager only for Shield Advanced users. The price is included in the AWS Shield Advanced subscription at no additional cost.

note: d062. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: the guide note 'Charges incurred by AWS Firewall Manager are for the underlying services' alone implied no Firewall Manager fee; the pricing page charges a monthly fee per policy per Region. Dollar amount: firewall-manager-policy-fee.
